name: 18-claim-gate-done-gate-and-ends
description: A custom model rule at before an agent starts it makes each claim provisional: the first passes and the claim completes with the claimant's key; another claimant releases its provisional claim, which withdraws its check; three different agents are refused on the second task, which is held with claim_gate_failed until the owner turns the rule off. A rule at when the review has passed fails and becomes a failed review with the check as its cause. Then each way a waiting command is ended from outside: the builder's lease ends under a pending submit, the review lease ends under a pending pass, and the owner cancels the task under a pending pass; each withdraws the check and its job, a result sent for a withdrawn job is refused, and the reviewer's next verdict is refused task_cancelled.
covers: PRD A rule on the move from Ready to In Progress, L390-L393, and plan SM-13, SM-14, SM-19: a provisional claim reserves the task with no lease; releasing it withdraws its check; a failed check lapses it; the third distinct seat refused holds the task with claim_gate_failed and its item, closed by turning the rule off.
PRD Pending transitions, L373, and plan SM-6: a gate failing at task.before_done is a failed review in full, with failed_rule_check_id, the review criterion reopened and the builder's fresh lease.

PRD Pending transitions, L376, L377, L919, and milestone 4 plan section 2.1 rule 11: a lease that ends under a pending submit, a review lease that ends under a pending pass and a Cancel each withdraw the waiting command's check (check.finished, withdrawn) and its job (job.withdrawn); the requester's command reads refused with lease_expired or task_cancelled, which no event carries.
Milestone 4 plan RD-41: a result for a withdrawn job is refused invalid_state and writes nothing.
PRD L919: after Cancel the holder's next call is refused task_cancelled.
Milestone 4 plan RD-44 and DB-25: a withdrawn check is run again as a new attempt of the same row, on a job of its own.
